project_info.theme: Gold stage performance look under a lavender spotlight
project_info.color_palette: gold beadwork, pale purple haze, black headset and warm skin highlights

main_subject.detail: Clearly adult female performer with long dark tight-crimped curls, soft neutral makeup, cat-eye eyeliner, rose-toned matte lips and natural stage-ready skin texture. She wears a structured gold embroidered corset-style crop top with a deep V neckline, matching high-waisted embellished shorts and sheer glittery gold tulle drapery attached at the shoulders like a floor-length cape. She wears a thin black headset microphone, raises one hand to her hair and keeps the other relaxed.

composition_elements.layout: vertical full-body-to-three-quarter stage portrait with performer angled slightly to highlight the outfit and flowing cape
composition_elements.background: soft hazy wash of lavender and pale purple stage light

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: front-left purple spotlight with controlled warm reflection on gold costume
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: luminous beadwork, realistic skin sheen, soft haze and confident stage atmosphere

technical_specs.optics: fast portrait lens, crisp costume texture and soft lavender background

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic vertical stage-performance portrait of a generic clearly adult female performer with long dark tight-crimped curls, high volume, soft neutral eyeshadow, defined cat-eye eyeliner, shimmering cheeks, matte rose-toned lips, realistic pores and a fresh stage-ready glow. She wears a structured gold corset-style crop top with a deep V neckline, intricate gold beadwork and embroidery, small dangling crystal beads, matching high-waisted gold shorts with dense embroidery and beadwork, and sheer glittery gold tulle fabric attached at the shoulders in a floor-length cape-like wing flow. Add a thin black headset microphone and minimal earrings. She raises her left hand to her hair while the right arm relaxes, with a focused confident expression and body angled to highlight the silhouette. Use a soft hazy wash of lavender and pale purple light with a front-left spotlight illuminating the gold outfit. Vertical 504:1002 composition, photorealistic detail and cinematic live-performance styling. Preserve the original stage costume, cape, pose and purple lighting without reproducing Jennie Kim or any public-figure likeness.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, duplicate cape, distorted microphone
